munit:test.name: deactivation-request-creates-ticket-for-the-product-line
munit:test.description: DEACTIVATION row (Neon CRM) + Opportunity whose Account has an instance id + no ticket in Jira -> ticket from mapping/deactivation-ticket.yaml -> registry Created

munit:test.description: The Account has no instance id for the line -> no Jira call; registry Failed - Terminal, category Mapping, message names the missing id

munit:test.name: deactivation-already-keyed-on-opportunity-is-skipped
munit:test.description: The Opportunity already carries a deactivation key for this line -> registry Cancelled, SKIPPED_EXISTING_KEY, no Jira call

munit:test.name: deactivation-links-a-ticket-jira-already-has-for-the-label
munit:test.description: Jira already holds a ticket with this request's label (write-back failed earlier) -> linked to the row, no second ticket

munit:test.name: deactivation-for-an-unconfigured-product-line-is-terminal
munit:test.description: config-test maps Arts People to project TBD (Neon One has not created ARTS) -> no Jira call; Failed - Terminal, Mapping, message names the line
